{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Number of -1 values in customer_age:", df['customer_age'].eq(-1).sum())

# Check for the presence of 999999.99 in revenue (QA orders)
print("Number of rows with revenue == '999999.99'", df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0])

# Check for refunded orders
print("Number of refunded orders:", df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0])

# Check revenue column: are all values valid numeric strings?
revenue_sample = df['revenue'].head(10)
print("Sample of revenue values:", revenue_sample.values)

# Check if revenue contains commas
print("Revenue contains commas?", df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).any())"}
